<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO with configurable parameters WIDTH and DEPTH.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data.</output>
    </ports>
    
    <!-- Parameter Description -->
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH">FIFO data width.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DEPTH">FIFO depth.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    
    <!-- Logic Description -->
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        // Declare necessary signals and variables here
        wire wen, ren;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] wdata_reg, rdata_reg;
        
        // Connect input signals to appropriate pins
        assign wen = winc && !wfull;
        assign ren = rinc && !rempty;
        assign wdata_reg = wdata;
        assign rdata = rdata_reg;
    </logic_description>
    
    <!-- Implementation Description -->
    <implementation>
        // Instantiate dual-port RAM module
        dual_port_RAM #(.DEPTH(DEPTH), .WIDTH(WIDTH)) ram(
            .wclk(wclk),
            .wenc(wen),
            .waddr(waddr),
            .wdata(wdata_reg),
            .rclk(rclk),
            .renc(ren),
            .raddr(raddr),
            .rdata(rdata_reg)
        );
        
        // Define internal registers for write and read pointers
        reg [$clog2(DEPTH):0] wptr, rptr;
        reg [$clog2(DEPTH):0] wptr_bin, rptr_bin;
        reg [$clog2(DEPTH):0] wptr_buff, rptr_buff;
        reg [$clog2(DEPTH):0] wptr_syn, rptr_syn;
        
        // Write Pointer Control
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                wptr <= 0;
                wptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (wen) begin
                    wptr <= wptr + 1;
                    wptr_buff <= wptr;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Read Pointer Control
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                rptr <= 0;
                rptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (ren) begin
                    rptr <= rptr + 1;
                    rptr_buff <= rptr;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Binary to Gray Code Conversion
        function automatic [$clog2(DEPTH)+1:0] bin_to_gray(input [$clog2(DEPTH)+1:0] bin);
            integer i;
            reg [$clog2(DEPTH)+1:0] temp;
            begin
                temp = bin;
                for (i = $clog2(DEPTH); i >= 0; i = i - 1) begin
                    bin_to_gray[i] = temp[i];
                    temp[i-1] = temp[i] ^ temp[i-1];
                end
            end
        endfunction
        
        // Gray Code to Binary Conversion
        function automatic [$clog2(DEPTH)+1:0] gray_to_bin(input [$clog2(DEPTH)+1:0] gray);
            integer i;
            reg [$clog2(DEPTH)+1:0] temp;
            begin
                temp[$clog2(DEPTH)] = gray[$clog2(DEPTH)];
                for (i = $clog2(DEPTH)-1; i >= 0; i = i - 1) begin
                    temp[i] = temp[i+1] ^ gray[i];
                end
                gray_to_bin = temp;
            end
        endfunction
        
        // Synchronize Write Pointer with Read Clock
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                wptr_syn <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_syn <= wptr_buff;
            end
        end
        
        // Synchronize Read Pointer with Write Clock
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                rptr_syn <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr_syn <= rptr_buff;
            end
        end
        
        // Full and Empty Signal Generation
        assign wfull = (wptr == {~rptr[4], rptr[3:0]});
        assign rempty = (rptr == wptr);
        
        // Assign write and read addresses
        assign waddr = wptr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0];
        assign raddr = rptr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0];
        
        // Update binary and Gray code pointers
        always @(*) begin
            wptr_bin = gray_to_bin(wptr);
            rptr_bin = gray_to_bin(rptr);
        end
        
        // Assign write and read enable signals
        assign wen = winc && !wfull;
        assign ren = rinc && !rempty;
    </implementation>
</module>
